# `api.jobs.shipment.get_shipping_export_data`

> `GET /job/{jobDisplayId}/shipment/exportdata/{shippingId}` — ACPortal

**Python**

```python
api.jobs.shipment.get_shipping_export_data(job_display_id: int, shipping_id: int) -> ShippingExportData | None
```

**CLI**

```bash
ab jobs shipment get_shipping_export_data <job_display_id> <shipping_id>
```

Read export data for an explicit integer ``Shipping.id``.
